releases.title: Guide & What's New
notes: New ℹ️ button in the header opens a Guide that explains every metric, color, and arrow.
What's New now flags updates with a dot on the ℹ️ icon and a one-time banner.
The Guide's legend always reflects the app's live thresholds, so it can't drift.
Rotation signal updated: short horizon is now week + month (day was too noisy); long horizon is now 3mo + 6mo + year.
Phase-history dots on AI cards redesigned as a clean CSS timeline — graduated opacity, connecting line, and dates on both ends.

releases.title: Momentum signals on every card
notes: Momentum cards now show an acceleration badge (▲▲/▲/▼/▼▼) so you can see momentum building or fading at a glance.
New Rotation sub-view splits groups into Emerging / Established / Fading.
Today cards gain a rank-trend arrow (↑/↓) plus a performance-delta context row when expanded.
Strength tab is now sorted by confirmed momentum.
Your Momentum / Rotation sub-view choice is remembered between visits, and lookback buttons are now read straight from the data.

releases.title: Richer momentum & longer lookbacks
notes: Lookback windows are now 5 / 10 / 20 / 50 trading sessions.
New confirmed-momentum, acceleration, regime, and rank-trend signals.
Rotation sub-view splits groups into Emerging / Established / Fading.

releases.title: Lookup tab upgrade
notes: Look up any ticker and see its sector/industry strength at a glance: a weekly-rank sparkline, a Rank Floor with a Sustained/Consistent conviction chip, and a breadth dot strip.
The Signal card now cites concrete evidence for its read instead of a bare label.
Added a 'Why this matters' glossary plus one-tap deep links to Finviz and TradingView charts.
Data fix: snapshots stamped on weekends or NYSE holidays are rolled back to the real trading day, so no phantom dates appear.

releases.title: More reliable AI notes
notes: The AI tab was rebuilt around a single plain-English note per group, replacing the brittle format that occasionally produced blank or garbled briefings.
Notes are now built directly from the computed signals — strength, movers, momentum leaders/laggards, and divergences — so they always render cleanly.

releases.title: Ticker Lookup arrives
notes: New Lookup tab: type a ticker to see its Finviz sector and industry, company profile, and how those groups are ranking.
Backed by a fast edge cache so repeat lookups return instantly.

releases.title: AI notes stop dropping out
notes: Fixed a daily-quota issue that could leave the AI note half-written or missing.
Partial results now resume and fill in only what's missing, so you get a complete note each day.

releases.title: A richer AI tab
notes: AI tab adds key-signal bullets, a collapsible briefing, and conviction tags.
New rotation phase + watchlist, a 'what changed' delta card, and a relative timestamp.
Share a briefing natively, scan a phase-history strip, and navigate back through past dates.

releases.title: AI daily notes
notes: The AI tab now writes a plain-English daily note per group.
Covers strength, movers & momentum, and divergences.

releases.title: Strength tab & AI Insights
notes: New Strength tab surfaces Sustained Strength (top-ranked across month/quarter/half at once) and an All-Green view where every timeframe is positive.
New rank-agreement signal measures how consistently a group ranks across timeframes.
First AI Insights: a nightly briefing for sectors and industries with a rotation-phase read and a top-sector watchlist.

releases.title: Finviz Groups Tracker launches
notes: Tracks every Finviz sector and industry group every trading day, so you can see where capital is rotating.
Installable iPhone app (Add to Home Screen) with three tabs to start: Today's color-coded performance, Movers leaderboard, and Momentum.
Rankings and rank/performance changes are computed daily across multiple lookbacks — rank 1 is always the strongest performer.
A companion Streamlit dashboard adds snapshots, time series, and downloadable CSVs for deeper analysis.
